modules.module_title: Prepare for setting the CNC turning machine

pcs.pc_description: use the relevant information from engineering drawings concerning the work to be undertaken for setting up the CNC machine

determine the job specifications by referring to job instruction sheet/job card, component drawing, work drawing, planning documentation; quality control documents; operation sheets, component drawings; approved sketches/illustrations, process drawing, etc.
analyse the component drawings and approved sketches/ illustrations/ reference charts/ tables/ graphs/ machining/ assembly drawings to determine the machining requirements
extract the relevant information such as tapping sizes and threads; feeds and speeds; component ratings; machining symbols and tolerances from reference charts, tables, graphs
check the process sheet and match it with the received drawings and other specifications
identify the tool requirements from the tooling layout and assess their suitability
check the availability of required cutting, measuring and hand tools
select the appropriate work holding/ fixturing device as per the job requirement
ensure the correct and latest part program is uploaded onto the CNC system
check the runout of chuck and the taper of tailstock are as recommended
pre-set the tooling appropriately using setting jigs/fixtures
check the measuring equipment to ensure they are calibrated and approved for use
check the tools and fixtures to ensure they are calibrated appropriately, and free from damage
mount tools in the correct position in the tool holder, turrets, magazine or carousel
check that tools have the required tool number in relation to the operating program
enter all the relevant tool data in the operating program and also part-program for cutting parts using the appropriate commands
set tool datum, position, length, offset and radius compensation, maintaining the recommended margin for error rectification
mount the work holding device/fixture onto the machine and set it according to the machine datum and reference points
set the machine tool operating parameters such as hydraulic pressure and clamping according to the component requirements
set the CNC machine in the correct operating mode, and enter the tooling data by accessing the program edit facility
conduct trial runs using single block run, dry run, and feed and speed override controls

check the geometrical accuracies of component such as diameter on multiple points, taper, surface finishing, grove depths and widths, drill depth, Outer Diameter (OD)/Inner Diameter (ID), threading quality and dimensions
check the allowable grinding margin on OD and ID
prove the program tool in single block mode and transfer the program to the machine

conduct multiple trial runs before allowing the machine to operate in full program run mode, and make appropriate adjustments to offsets to ensure accuracy in the critical parameters of the components to be machined
carry out necessary documentation as per the organisational procedure for the handover of the machine
follow the appropriate troubleshooting steps to resolve issues experienced with setting up of the tooling, work holding devices and proving the program
check if the CNC turning/lathe machine responds to emergency commands and actions
check the tools/ fixtures for damage during the prove-out
carry out appropriate documentation with respect to the setting of the machine and checks conducted
coordinate with an expert to resolve any issues encountered while setting up the CNC machine

modules.module_title: Prepare for carrying out turning operations

pcs.pc_description: select the appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for the turning operations
assess the hazards at the worksite and coordinate with the supervisor or relevant personnel to deal with them
check the process sheet and match it with the received drawings and other specifications
check the availability of the required tools and measuring instruments
select the relevant hand and mechanised tools and equipment and check them to ensure they are safe to be used
repair or replace the worn-out PPE, tools and equipment, as appropriate

determine the job specifications by referring to job instruction sheet/job card, component drawing, work drawing, planning documentation; quality control documents; operation sheets, component drawings; approved sketches/illustrations, process drawing, etc.
select the appropriate raw materials or components for the turning operations after checking it to ensure it has the required characteristics
check the post-machining sheet to determine if the component meets the applicable quality standards from previous machining operations
coordinate with the supervisor or relevant personnel for the correction of incorrect and inconsistent information in the job specification documents, following the applicable organisational procedure
prepare the work area for the turning operations as per the applicable procedure or operational specifications
check for safe resting of the component on resting pads and clamping load of fixture
carry out daily maintenance of turning machine, following the maintenance checklist and applicable procedures
check the availability of required workpieces/raw materials, consumables, cutting, measuring and hand tools as per the job requirements
check the components before use to ensure they are free from foreign objects, dirt or other contamination
conduct the appropriate preliminary checks on the CNC turning machine as per the relevant checklist to ensure its readiness for use
carry out minor repair and maintenance on the CNC turning machine and coordinate with an expert to resolve any complex issues
check to ensure all the measuring instruments are calibrated and approved for use
set workpieces as per the job requirements using appropriate positioning or holding devices and support mechanisms
check that the operating program is at the correct start point and the tool is at a safe position, clear of the part
load and unload component(s) using the appropriate fixtures or work holding devices as appropriate
check the correctness of the program by conducting a dry run and single block check
carry out first part cutting trial by setting tool offsets to get oversize part
identify abnormal noises coming from the machine and component, and adjust the feed and Revolutions Per Minute (RPM), as required
measure the critical parameters of the machined components without removing them from the machine, such as linear dimensions, slots, flatness, surface finish, etc
correct the offsets based on the measurements by accessing the program edit facility and enter the tooling data
adhere to the information provided in the reference charts, tables, graphs, component drawing, engineering drawing, dimensioning and labelling data drawing
check the messages shown on the CNC machine’s visual display regularly and take appropriate action
restart the program from the correct restart point when the machine is been stopped before the completion of the program
carry out a range of turning operations to ensure the machined components have the required features, faces, undercuts, profiles, holes, parting-off and threads, etc.
follow the appropriate machining sequence and procedures as per the job specifications
follow the manufacturer’s instructions and organisational guidelines to deal with machine alarms and errors
inspect the machine and machined components as per recommended frequency given in the inspection plan
record the measured values as per the organisational procedure and complete the post- machining inspection sheet
identify inconsistencies in dimensions due to tool wear and correct the offsets accordingly
adjust various machine settings according to the operations requirements, when required
identify the worn-out and damaged tools and equipment
repair or replace the worn tool and damaged tools and equipment, as appropriate
cut a trial part and adjust the tool offsets after each tool change
handle and store the raw material and finished components as per organisational policy
check the finished components to ensure they conform to the applicable specifications and quality standards
use the relevant Industry 4.0 manufacturing technologies to ensure interconnectivity, automation, machine learning, and real-time data collection and analysis
follow the manufacturer’s instructions while operating the CNC turning machine
coordinate with the relevant personnel to resolve issues encountered with turning operations
store the machinery, tools and equipment at the designated location on the completion of turning operations
follow the organisational policy to ensure a safe and hygienic work area, such as safe isolation of machinery, removal and disposal of waste, regular maintenance of machinery, use of relevant PPE
use electricity and other resources optimally in various tasks and processes
connect electrical tools and equipment safely and turn them off when they are not in use
